name: MilestoneTable
intent: A collapsible milestones table (swatch + id, actual date or “—”, planned date) with zebra striping. Complements ProgressComparison's milestone stepper when the exact dates matter.
when: Listing milestones with their actual vs planned dates
Adding a detailed dated milestone table beside a progress comparison

chooseOver.because: MilestoneTable is a dated, collapsible table; ProgressComparison shows a compact inline milestone stepper

notes: authored during the develop merge reconciliation

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Wrap the table in a collapsible section with a toggle header. Default true.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state (collapsible only). Default true.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.

usage: Use MilestoneTable to help users navigate through your application or content hierarchy. This component provides clear wayfinding and helps users understand their current location within the interface.

MilestoneTable is ideal for multi-page applications, content-heavy interfaces, or any situation where users need to move between different sections. Keep navigation patterns consistent across your application for better user experience.

bestPractices.title: Keep tabs concise
bestPractices.description: Use short, descriptive labels for tab triggers.

bestPractices.title: Don't use long tab labels
bestPractices.description: Avoid lengthy text that causes tabs to wrap or overflow.

bestPractices.title: Maintain content relationship
bestPractices.description: Ensure tab content is clearly related to the tab label.

bestPractices.title: Don't use for navigation
bestPractices.description: Use proper navigation components for page-level routing.

bestPractices.title: Show active state clearly
bestPractices.description: Make the selected tab visually distinct from others.

bestPractices.title: Don't hide the active indicator
bestPractices.description: Always show which tab is currently selected.
